selected_bottleneck: repo-context-bounded-path-identity（仓库上下文有界路径身份完整性）
selected_problem: Fresh main still let lexical aliases such as src/a.js, src/a.js/, src/./a.js, src//a.js and src/tmp/../a.js consume distinct bounded context-selection and exact-path-index slots even though downstream workspace, semantic, federated and changeset layers had already converged these regular-file spellings. The defect is directly falsifiable without choosing a new repository-context architecture.
decision_basis: The defect is a fresh-main consistency gap in bounded repository observation, not a request to preselect UI, module-resolution or synthesis architecture.
The fix reuses the same POSIX lexical normalization already established by adjacent Taowind Code path-identity layers and deduplicates before maxFiles/maxPaths budgets are consumed.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502, so this cycle uses DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY（DWAC 源码契约重放） and does not claim a hosted DWAC success receipt.
change: repo-context now performs POSIX lexical normalization, leading ./ cleanup and trailing-separator collapse before bounded selection/index identity. selectContextPaths deduplicates canonical paths before maxFiles is consumed; repositoryPathIndex uses the same canonical identity before maxPaths/maxBytes accounting.

validation.focused_tests: 2/2 PASS, 0 skipped: repository context path identity + host-locale determinism
validation.base_main_existing_note: tests/repo-context-path-index.test.mjs already contains one unrelated ordering expectation that fails on base main; this candidate does not change that comparator behavior and does not claim it closed.

truth_boundary: This closes lexical alias duplication in bounded repository context selection and exact-path indexing. It does not claim filesystem case/Unicode equivalence, canonical metadata arbitration for conflicting duplicate manifest rows, exhaustive large-repository coverage, parser-grade module semantics, or arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
